title: iPad mini (A20 Pro) review: Apple's tiny tablet gets a big update
method: Hands-on review of a 256 GB model with nano-texture glass.

findings.subject: apple-ipad-mini-a20-pro
findings.text: The first OLED screen in an iPad mini gives deep blacks and much better HDR; nano-texture glass makes it easy to use near bright lights. It stays at 60 Hz, a let-down at this price.

findings.subject: apple-ipad-mini-a20-pro
findings.text: The new speakers have much stronger bass; the previous iPad mini sounds tinny next to it.

findings.subject: apple-ipad-mini-a20-pro
findings.text: The A20 Pro handled everything, including console ports such as Control and No Man's Sky.

findings.subject: apple-ipad-mini-a20-pro
findings.text: From $699, $200 more than the last model at launch; nano-texture glass needs the $899 256 GB model, so the reviewer doubts it is worth it for most people.
